create_HermesDetector: create a HermesDetector instance to detect and parse Hermes-format tool calls from model output text
parse_HermesDetector_detect_and_parse: parse a text string for Hermes-format tool calls and return structured call results with normal text
parse_HermesDetector_parse_streaming_inc: parse streaming text incrementally to extract normal text and tool calls as they arrive
test_HermesDetector_has_tool_call: test whether a text string contains a Hermes-format tool call trigger token
review_HermesDetector_structure_info: review the structure_info method that returns begin/end/trigger tokens for Hermes tool call format
